description: Bus command to unarchive a previously archived resource.

_userId.description: Authenticated user's DID, injected by the /bus/emit gateway. Clients do not set this.

storageUri.description: Optional: where the resource's bytes are expected to be. When present the handler VERIFIES the file exists and fails loudly if it does not, rather than succeeding as a no-op. An instruction, not a copy of the stored fact (that lives on the primary Representation). Working-tree URI, only file:// is supported.
